notes: tier-readability (Docs/Zones.md): default named zones per map, realm-local centimetres (the same frame as MapLayout.json), shared by both realms. Entering a zone shows the WoW zone text with its name and 'Monster Tier: X', the most common tier of the challenge packs inside it (ties go to the higher tier). A layout with Zone markers (map layout editor, Shift+3) replaces these for its map; the editor's USE DEFAULT ZONES button copies these into the layout so they can be renamed and redrawn. The first zone containing a point wins. The castletown zones were derived from Eric's layout v2 pack clusters and the explore landmarks (CastleTown.json); the procedural town without an entry uses its TownLayout.json districts.
